name: How long does a typical threshold repair or replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical threshold repair or replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a threshold repair or replacement project can vary based on the extent of the damage, the type of material, and whether other structural issues are discovered. A simple replacement of a standard threshold might take a few hours. However, if there's significant rot extending into the door frame or subfloor, or if custom fitting is required, the project could extend to a full day or potentially longer. We provide an estimated timeline after a thorough assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple repairs may take a few hours; complex issues or custom work could extend to a full day or more.
